sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004 — Building Maintenance and Occupancy Requirements
sources.description: Code provisions requiring buildings to be maintained in a safe and sanitary condition, affecting maintenance access and material selection.

sources.label: RA 9003: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act — Maintenance and Waste Management
sources.description: Requires integrated waste management facilities in building and site design including waste storage, segregation areas, and collection access.
